notes.title: GAME RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Hello, bread warriors!

Today is an important day for us because we’ve just released our first full game on Steam. And the best part? You can play it absolutely for free!

Yes, you heard that right. The full version of Breadborn is available for free to everyone! :)

So go check out the new trailer and download the game. Get ready for a thrilling gameplay experience, where you control Kolobok and his army of crumbly minions. Devour them for extra protection, send the little ones to attack enemies. But be careful — the local beasts love snacking on tiny pieces of bread.

[previewyoutube=8cKvgiFj42k;full]https://youtu.be/8cKvgiFj42k[/previewyoutube]

Arm yourself with a variety of weapons and fight your way through! All to lift the curses of Baba Yaga. And don’t worry about dying — each attempt grants you experience and a burning desire for revenge.

_________________

We’re eagerly awaiting your feedback and hope you enjoy the game!
